crossRefs.note: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall…
He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
If one man sins against another, God will judge him; but if a man sins against Yahweh, who will intercede for him?”…
How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings…
Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for…
According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
I am among those who are peaceable and faithful in Israel. You seek to destroy a city and a mother in Israel. Why will…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

translations.web: and David said to the Gibeonites, “What should I do for you? And with what should I make atonement, that you may bless Yahweh’s inheritance?”
translations.bsb: So David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you? How can I make amends so that you may bless the inheritance of the LORD?”
translations.kjv: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?
translations.asv: and David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of Jehovah?
